title: The empty restriction as a right identity for composition
statement: Let $\rho$ be a restriction on $n$ variables, and let $\varnothing$ denote the empty restriction that leaves every variable free. Then the composition of $\rho$ with $\varnothing$, applying $\rho$ first and then $\varnothing$ on the variables $\rho$ leaves free, equals $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: ρ is a restriction on n variables
the second argument is the all-free restriction (fun _ => none)
replaced:
Composing a restriction $\rho$ with the all-free restriction (which fixes no
variable) returns $\rho$ unchanged.
